changelog: Complete Sovereign Vault UI Redesign: Ground-up overhaul using Stitch cyber-fintech obsidian interfaces with zero performance drops (strictly no blur).
Direct 3D Card Studio Workflow: Ordering a card opens the interactive 3D studio directly and syncs newly minted cards to the player's account in real-time with zero interface reloads.
SharkPay Lore Network Branding: Completely replaced all real-world Mastercard brand elements with 100% FiveM TOS compliant SharkPay emblems across all cards, ATM interfaces, and card studios.

High-Yield Upgradable Savings Vault: Full in-UI tier progression (Standard, Évolué, Prestige, and VIP Patrimonial) featuring live capacity gauges, instant compound interest simulators, and quick deposit/withdrawal presets.
Fixed Black Card unlimited spending & ATM daily limit bug where withdrawals were incorrectly blocked by ATM checks.
NUI Memory Leak & CEF Optimization: Fully implemented dynamic DOM mounting/unmounting architecture (// @cef-zero-leak) with total garbage collection cleanup when closed.
Removed legacy handheld POS / TPE terminal files and configuration overhead completely.
